stem.text: A steel ball is dropped from rest from a height $h$ above the ground. The ball hits the ground after a time $t$.
This is repeated for a number of different heights.
The graph shows the variation of $h$ with $t^{2}$ for the ball.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled h and horizontal axis labelled t2, showing a straight line through the origin.

stem.text: The gradient of the graph is $G$.
Which expression gives the acceleration of the ball?
